_about: Site settings. suggestions: where the suggestion form sends entries. Leave action empty until a form service is set up; the page then says suggestions aren't connected yet. Works with any service that accepts a plain HTML form POST: Formspree (action = https://formspree.io/f/<id>, fields name/message/page), or a Google Form (action = https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/<id>/formResponse, fields = the form's entry.NNNN ids; set no_cors true).
